name: continue-plugin
description: Auto-continues an OpenCode 2 agent until it declares the job done

scripts.deploy: cp plugin/continue.ts "$HOME/.config/opencode/plugins/continue.ts" && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/opencode/plugins/continue-tui" && cp plugin/tui.tsx "$HOME/.config/opencode/plugins/continue-tui/tui.tsx" && cp plugin/tui-package.json "$HOME/.config/opencode/plugins/continue-tui/package.json"
